name: Facturalia Peppol Invoicing for WooCommerce
author: Pascal De Kaey

sections.description:
This plugin adds a WooCommerce submenu where you can enter and validate your
Facturalia API key, as well as manage basic invoicing settings
(layout, email template, autosend, language, paid status, exemption).
Once an order reaches the Completed status, it is sent to your
Facturalia account. There, an invoice is generated automatically and — if enabled —
delivered to the customer. If your customer is connected to the Peppol network,
the invoice is sent via Peppol; otherwise, it is delivered by email.

For more details see the knowledge base:
https://welkom.facturalia.be/kennisbank/woocommerce-peppol-plugin/
Note: This plugin is designed for businesses operating in Belgium and follows Belgian Peppol e-invoicing rules.

Requirements
* WordPress 6.x+
* WooCommerce activated
* Facturalia API key

External services

This plugin connects to an API in order to transfer completed WooCommerce orders to Facturalia where it will generate an invoice for the client.
It sends all neccessary order data that Facturalia needs to generate the invoice.
This API-service is provided by Facturalia, a Belgian e-invoicing platform: terms of use, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ZIP file via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
    2 Activate the plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Facturalia.
  3. Paste your API key and click Validate key. If successful, “Hallo ” appears.
  4. Fill in the remaining settings and click Save changes.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin automatically create an invoice?

Yes. When the order status reaches Completed.

Does this support Peppol?

Yes. Invoices are sent via Peppol when the customer is registered on the network; otherwise they are sent by email.

Is this plugin available outside Belgium?

Currently this plugin is intended for the Belgian market.

  • Automatic invoicing on Completed status and delivery via Peppol or email.
